name: CASC-J11
description: The CADE ATP System Competition (CASC) is the annual evaluation of fully automatic, classical logic, Automated Theorem Proving (ATP) systems. CASC-J11 was the twenty-seventh competition in the CASC series. Twenty-four ATP systems competed in the various competition divisions. This paper presents an outline of the competition design and a commentated summary of the results.
general_score_metric: theorems_proved (number of problems proved / success rate)
notes: Competition benchmark for automated theorem provers (non-LLM); scoring is time- and resource-dependent and varies by division. Risk of dataset overlap with training corpora for models trained on theorem repositories; not a single fixed dataset (competition suite changes across years).
